descriptionPlain:
About Bazaarvoice
 
At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
 
The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.
 
Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
 
Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
 
It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

lists.content:
• Orchestrate the Territory Ecosystem: Act as the strategic leader of your territory. Conduct account planning, territory management, and continuous pipeline generation, while rallying internal cross-functional resources to maximize coverage and close deals.

  • End-to-End Deal Architecture: Manage the entire lifecycle of high-value enterprise SaaS deals—from initial prospecting and precise qualification to sophisticated contract negotiation and closure.

  • Strategic Opportunity Mapping: Move beyond standard discovery to conduct deep-dive analyses into a retailer's business model. Reveal latent pain points and align Bazaarvoice’s high-ROI solutions with their business objectives.

  • Value Defense & Executive Presence: Partner with a prospect’s marketing, merchandising, and technology staff. Confidently demonstrate and defend the ROI of our platform, successfully building consensus from Marketing Managers up to CMO, CTO, and Procurement levels.

  • High-Velocity Discipline & Forecasting: Drive urgency throughout the sales funnel, handle objections with resilience, and maintain a high volume of outbound activity. Deliver exceptional qualification and accurate forecasting over a two-quarter period.

  • Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of e-commerce industry trends, competitor movements, and shifts in consumer behavior to provide proactive strategic guidance.

• Proven Track Record: 3 year experience in a customer-facing, new-business SaaS hunter role, with a proven history of managing high-value portfolios and consistently exceeding quotas.

  • Retail & Digital Savvy: Strong knowledge of and experience selling into large, complex retail organizations.

  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Expert in value-selling innovative software in a fast-changing space. Ability to articulate complex ROI models and use data-driven storytelling to win complex "consensus" buys.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead internal support teams, articulate a clear account strategy, and secure the internal resources needed to win.

  • The Bazaarvoice DNA: A high level of enthusiasm, coachability, and an unwavering work ethic. You are comfortable hearing "no," shaking it off, and pivoting your strategy to find the "yes."

  • Language: French language proficiency at Native or C1 minimum.

  • Right to Work: Eligibility to work in France without restrictions.

• Industry Background: 3+ years of experience selling e-commerce, MarTech, or digital marketing technology, with established relationships up to the CMO level.

  • Brand Experience: Experience selling to large consumer brands in addition to major retailers.

  • Global Mindset: Additional European language skills are a strong plus.

• Net New Revenue: Driving net new business within the Retail segment.

  • Pipeline Velocity & Accuracy: Consistently generating pipeline and moving opportunities through the funnel with speed and precise forecasting.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Successfully leveraging and orchestrating your internal support resources to maximize territory efficiency and deal sizes.

lists.content:
• Partner closely with Product Marketing, Client Success, Sales, and Support to orchestrate frictionless Product Launch Readiness (GTM) processes.
  • Oversee the strategy and execution of the Product Knowledge team, ensuring the product knowledge base and technical communications remain accurate, accessible, and up to date for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure front-line teams are equipped with product knowledge, documentation, release notes, and operational training prior to feature rollouts.
  • Establish closed-loop feedback systems to aggregate Voice of Customer (VoC) and Voice of Field data into Product Management prioritization.
  • Product Governance & Roadmap Operations
  • Standardize and elevate the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle (PDLC), from opportunity discovery through execution and launch.
  • Maintain cross-team visibility into product roadmaps, keeping Product Management, Engineering, Design, and leadership aligned on progress and status.
  • Own and optimize the Product tech stack (e.g., Notion, Pendo, Jira, Confluence, Gong) to drive data-informed decision-making and operational efficiency.
  • Champion AI-driven process optimization across the Product organization to streamline workflows, reduce manual overhead, and drive operational consistency across teams.
  • Define and track key product health metrics, feature adoption rates, and operational efficiency metrics across the portfolio.
  • Lead, coach, and empower a team of 3 individual Program Managers fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and results-driven culture.
  • Establish clear team KPIs, resource allocation models, and career development pathways for your direct reports.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex operational roadblocks across product lines

• 10+ years of total experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management in a fast-paced B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • 4+ years of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of leading, developing, and scaling high-performing program managers and technical communications or documentation functions.
  • Deep Product Ops Expertise: Demonstrated success building or maturing a Product Operations function from early/mid-stage to enterprise scale.
  • AI-First Operational Mindset: Proven track record of evaluating and integrating AI technologies into operational workflows to reduce manual effort, automate repeatable tasks, and ensure organizational consistency.
  • Knowledge and Comms Management: Experience managing internal and external product knowledge bases, technical writing, and release communication frameworks..
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency with key product platforms, analytics, and AI tools, including Notion, Pendo, Claude Cowork, Jira, Confluence, and Gong.
  •  Exceptional ability to synthesize complex quantitative data and qualitative feedback into actionable operational strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Outstanding communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills to align diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS without direct authority.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving clarity, and scaling processes within a dynamic, matrixed environment.

lists.content:
1. Nurture and Expand Strategic Accounts

  • Account Launch, Retention & Growth: Serve as the trusted lead for key LLM and AI partners (e.g., Google, OpenAI, hyperscalers, AEO/GEO companies, and emerging AI commerce players), consistently deepening executive relationships and identifying new avenues for mutual growth.

  • Account Health & Governance: Establish and lead structured account management cadences (QBRs, strategic joint roadmapping, executive steering committees) to ensure alignment, resolve operational friction, and secure durable partnership renewals.

    • 2. Maximize Account Value & Expand Usage

  • Integration Optimization: Drive cross-functional initiatives to scale existing pilots into permanent, core integrations, demonstrating continuously how Bazaarvoice data improves LLM-powered search, recommendation, and agentic shopping outcomes.

  • Value Realization: Collaborate with partners on success metrics (e.g., conversion lift, engagement, relevance) to ensure ROI is consistently measured, reported, and leveraged to unlock broader usage tiers.

  • Expansion Storytelling: Package account successes, performance gains, and case studies to advocate for broader rollouts across additional partner product lines and business units.

    • 3. Orchestrate Internally Across Sales, Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Legal

  • Drive understanding and sales enablement across the sales organization at Bazaarvoice and within partner sales team to maximize partner success and adoption

  • Partner Voice in Product: Translate ongoing partner feedback and evolving technical needs into actionable insights for Product and Engineering; ensure existing APIs, data feeds, and integrations are continually optimized.

  • Contract Evolution & Governance: Work closely with Legal to update client terms, navigate complex data privacy and retention discussions, and co-lead renegotiations or amendments as partnership scopes expand over time.

    • 4. Optimize Commercial Frameworks & Account Economics (Non-Quota)

  • Value Maximization: Refine non-quota commercial models (tiered access, usage expansion, co-marketing, joint GTM value) to capture increasing economic value as accounts mature.

  • Internal Value Alignment: Partner with Revenue, Finance, and Strategy to track the expanding baseline value of AI partnerships and reflect account health in corporate performance.

    • 5. Be the Dedicated Advocate for Key Accounts

  • Strategic Representation: Represent Bazaarvoice and your assigned portfolio with senior partner executives and key client stakeholders, advocating for the long-term value of Bazaarvoice's authenticated UGC network in AI commerce.

Partnership and ecosystem leadership

  • 8+ years in strategic partnerships, platform partnerships, or ecosystem leadership roles, with a strong emphasis on data, platforms, and/or adtech/eCommerce.

  • Demonstrated success building and nurturing senior-level relationships with large technology platforms (e.g., hyperscalers, major ad platforms, LLM providers), including aligning on joint strategy and executing multi-phase roadmaps.

  • Proven experience turning emerging technology shifts (e.g., AI, privacy changes) into concrete partner offerings and measurable client value.

    • Commercial and product-oriented thinking

  • Track record structuring complex data or platform partnerships where value is created through integration, usage, and proof of performance, not just contract size.

  • Experience partnering closely with product and engineering teams to inform roadmaps and translate partnership opportunities into scalable, real-world products and integrations.

    • Governance, policy, and risk navigation

  • Comfort operating at the intersection of legal, privacy, and commercial outcomes—shaping pragmatic, scalable positions on data rights, training usage, and acceptable use, while enabling innovation.

  • Experience in environments where authenticity, trust, and sustainability are central to the value proposition is a plus.

• Relationship-first operator who derives energy from building long-term, trust-based partnerships while still moving quickly to tangible proof points.

  • Strategic, systems-level thinker who can connect macro industry shifts in AI and commerce to specific partnership structures and experiments.

  • Highly collaborative, low-ego leader who is comfortable influencing without direct authority across Strategy, Product, Engineering, Legal, and GTM.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-kind work; you default to test-and-learn, not endless debate.

As technology advances, so do our legal needs. lists.content:
• Provide forward-looking legal advice on all technology-related matters, including software development, cloud computing, artificial intelligence (GenAI/LLMs), and machine learning initiatives.
  • Embed with product and engineering teams to review new features and products from ideation to launch, ensuring privacy-by-design and AI-safety-by-design principles are met.
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous updating of company policies related to acceptable AI use, AI governance, data privacy, open-source licensing, and intellectual property.
  • Monitor and interpret emerging technology laws and regulations globally, with a specific focus on AI regulations (e.g., the EU AI Act, state-level algorithmic bias laws), data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA), and cybersecurity mandates.
  • Identify potential legal and ethical risks related to technology projects particularly those involving automated decision-making or AI-generated content and develop actionable strategies to mitigate them.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate high-stakes technology agreements, including SaaS, PaaS, strategic partnerships, and complex technology vendor contracts.
  • Scrutinize agreements with AI model providers and platforms, focusing on critical issues such as data usage rights (model training), IP indemnification, output ownership, and confidentiality.
  • Advise on the protection and enforcement of the company’s intellectual property, including patents, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyrights specifically addressing novel IP challenges related to AI-generated content and open-source software.
  • Partner closely with IT, Security, Privacy, and Compliance teams to ensure data workflows, especially those feeding into data lakes or AI models, comply with strict privacy and security standards.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership across IT, Security, Product Development, Engineering, Sales, and Business Development.
  • Develop and deliver training to employees on relevant legal topics, including responsible AI usage, technology contract fundamentals, IP protection, and data privacy best practices.

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one state bar.
  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience (in-house tech experience strongly preferred) with a deep focus on product counseling, regulatory compliance, and technology transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data privacy. You should understand how LLMs work, how data is used to train them, and the legal nuances of generative AI.
  • Strong working knowledge of global data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA) and a strong grasp of the emerging regulatory landscape for AI and digital services.
  • Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory risks into practical, actionable business advice for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously, lead cross-functional initiatives, and influence executive decision-making.
  • Prior experience building or scaling an AI Governance framework or AI review committee.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CIPP/US, CIPP/E) are a plus.
  • Background or undergraduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.

You sit at the intersection of CS strategy, data, and systems, turning customer signals into clear priorities and repeatable programs for our CSMs and leaders. Success looks like trusted CS metrics and benchmarks, a connected and well-governed CS tech stack, and a growing set of automated and agent-assisted workflows that give our CSMs time back to spend with customers.

As Bazaarvoice evolves how we serve customers in an AI-driven commerce landscape, we are also evolving how we run Customer Success. lists.content:
• Lead, coach, and develop the CS Operations team, including a CS Analyst and a Gainsight Administrator. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and manage priorities and intake so the team focuses on what matters most to retention and growth.
  • Own the CS metrics framework, including gross revenue retention and net revenue retention, churn, customer health, adoption, time-to-value, and risk forecasting. Establish benchmarks by segment and region, and turn trends into recommendations for resourcing, coverage, and customer engagement strategy.
  • Own the strategy and governance of the CS tech stack (Gainsight, Staircase AI, Salesforce, and Gong), with your Admin handling day-to-day configuration. Ensure data flows cleanly between systems and is trusted and well documented.
  • Turn customer signals, such as Gong call insights, Staircase relationship and sentiment data, usage, and support activity, into timely risk and opportunity alerts for CSMs.
  • Identify, prioritize, and help implement agentic and AI-assisted workflows across the customer lifecycle, such as account research and QBR prep, call summarization, risk detection, renewal preparation, and CS data hygiene. Define success metrics and human-in-the-loop guardrails for each.
  • Support renewal and forecasting rigor and optimize coverage by partnering with CS and Sales leadership on forecast inputs, risk reviews, CSM capacity, book-of-business design, and segmentation.
  • Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and enablement for CSMs across escalation, QBR and renewal motions as the business scales.
  • Champion the voice of the customer by synthesizing feedback and behavioral trends into insights for CS, Sales & Product.

  • 2+ years of experience leading, managing, or formally mentoring others, such as analysts, administrators, or CSMs, with a track record of developing people
  • Strong working knowledge of Gainsight and hands-on Salesforce experience, plus working experience with Gong and Staircase AI (or similar conversation and relationship intelligence tools)
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven record of measuring and benchmarking key CS metrics (retention, churn, NRR/GRR, health, adoption) and translating the data into decisions
  • Experience with SaaS or subscription-based business models, ideally with enterprise customers
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests, communicate clearly with CSMs and executives, and collaborate across Sales, Support, Product, Finance, and RevOps

• Prior experience as a CSM or CS leader, bringing firsthand understanding of the day-to-day customer motion
  • Experience designing, piloting, or scaling AI-assisted or agentic workflows in a CS or revenue organization
  • Experience building out an Operations or Analytics team, managing a technical administrator, or leading change management and CS enablement
  • Strong SQL and BI skills (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Looker)
  • Experience in ecommerce, retail, marketing technology, or UGC/reviews platforms, or supporting a global CS team
